Payment & late arrival policy

  • Appointments are for Haircut & Dye only.
  • Appointments are paid upfront, with a R30 appointment fee.
  • Grace period: 10 minutes after your booked time.
  • 11–20 minutes late: R15 late fee added to your service price.
  • More than 20 minutes late: R30 late fee, and your slot may be given to the next client or moved to the next available time.
  • Running late? WhatsApp 060 462 2866 before your time so Larkay can adjust.

Pay by EFT

Use your full name as the payment reference, then WhatsApp your proof of payment to 060 462 2866 to secure your slot.

By submitting, you are sending a booking request, not an instant guaranteed appointment. Larkay should confirm the slot with you. Appointments are paid upfront (R30 appointment fee) and late arrivals are subject to the penalty above.
